Wall did not walk up to his previous form and we did miss our Jimmy, who was getting over an attack of influenza. We must really congratulate the members who were outside the team honours as they all improved on last years figures.
The team that won in 1925 was: Rickards (2), Cooper (3), Wall (11), Hare (12). These figures are arrived at after eliminating the individual walkers.
